title: Serving The True Guru, The Lord Abides
subtitle: Siree Raag · Ang 69
summary: Ego is carried here from serving the True Guru, the Lord abides within the mind, and no trace of toward o Nanak, the devotees are happy and peaceful forever. They are absorbed in the.
whyItMatters: This shabad is useful when life feels inflated, defensive, self-protective, because it keeps ego inside remembrance, conduct, and the Creator's larger care instead of private mood.
takeaway: Ego steadies when o Nanak, the devotees are happy and peaceful forever. They are absorbed in the.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seviaai man niramalaa bhe pavit sareer ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes immaculate, and the body becomes pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man aana(n)dh sadhaa sukh paiaa bheTiaa gahir ga(n)bheer ||
lines.translation: The mind obtains bliss and eternal peace, meeting with the Deep and Profound Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਬੈਸਣਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sachee sa(n)gat baisanaa sach naam man dheer ||1||
lines.translation: Sitting in the Sangat, the True Congregation, the mind is comforted and consoled by the True Name. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਿਸੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man re satigur sev nisa(n)g ||
lines.translation: O mind, serve the True Guru without hesitation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਤੰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seviaai har man vasai lagai na mail pata(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, the Lord abides within the mind, and no trace of filth shall attach itself to you. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sabadh pat uoopajai sache sachaa naau ||
lines.translation: From the True Word of the Shabad comes honor. True is the Name of the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee haumai maar pachhaaniaa hau tin balihaarai jaau ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who conquer their ego and recognize the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਤਿਨ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: manmukh sach na jaananee tin Thaur na katahoo thaau ||2||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the True One; they find no shelter, and no place of rest anywhere. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach khaanaa sach painanaa sache hee vich vaas ||
lines.translation: Those who take the Truth as their food and the Truth as their clothing, have their home in the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadhaa sachaa saalaahanaa sachai sabadh nivaas ||
lines.translation: They constantly praise the True One, and in the True Word of the Shabad they have their dwelling.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sabh aatam raam pachhaaniaa gurmatee nij ghar vaas ||3||
lines.translation: They recognize the Lord, the Supreme Soul in all, and through the Guru's Teachings they dwell in the home of their own inner self. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach vekhan sach bolanaa tan man sachaa hoi ||
lines.translation: They see the Truth, and they speak the Truth; their bodies and minds are True.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachee saakhee upadhes sach sache sachee soi ||
lines.translation: True are their teachings, and True are their instructions; True are the reputations of the true ones.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿੰਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਚਲੇ ਰੋਇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: ji(n)nee sach visaariaa se dhukhe'ee chale roi ||4||
lines.translation: Those who have forgotten the True One are miserable-they depart weeping and wailing. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸੇ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur jinee na sevio se kit aae sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: Those who have not served the True Guru-why did they even bother to come into the world?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਕੂਕ ਨ ਸੁਣੈ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jam dhar badhe maare'eh kook na sunai pookaar ||
lines.translation: They are bound and gagged and beaten at Death's door, but no one hears their shrieks and cries.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: birathaa janam gavaiaa mar ja(n)meh vaaro vaar ||5||
lines.translation: They waste their lives uselessly; they die and are reincarnated over and over again. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਲਤਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਭਜਿ ਪਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: eh jag jalataa dhekh kai bhaj pe satigur saranaa ||
lines.translation: Seeing this world on fire, I rushed to the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sach dhiRaiaa sadhaa sach sa(n)jam rahanaa ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has implanted the Truth within me; I dwell steadfastly in Truth and self-restraint.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sachaa hai bohithaa sabadhe bhavajal taranaa ||6||
lines.translation: The True Guru is the Boat of Truth; in the Word of the Shabad, we cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫਿਰਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh firadhe rahe bin satigur mukat na hoiee ||
lines.translation: People continue wandering through the cycle of 8.4 million incarnations; without the True Guru, liberation is not obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਥਕੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: paR paR pa(n)ddit monee thake dhoojai bhai pat khoiee ||
lines.translation: Reading and studying, the Pandits and the silent sages have grown weary, but attached to the love of duality, they have lost their honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sabadh sunaiaa bin sache avar na koiee ||7||
lines.translation: The True Guru teaches the Word of the Shabad; without the True One, there is no other at all. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਚੈ ਲਾਏ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੇ ਨਿਤ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo sachai laae se sach lage nit sachee kaar kara(n)n ||
lines.translation: Those who are linked by the True One are linked to Truth. They always act in Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਰਹੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tinaa nij ghar vaasaa paiaa sachai mahal raha(n)n ||
lines.translation: They attain their dwelling in the home of their own inner being, and they abide in the Mansion of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਚੰਨਿ ॥੮॥੧੭॥੮॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagat sukhe'ee sadhaa sachai naam racha(n)n ||8||17||8||25||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the devotees are happy and peaceful forever. They are absorbed in the True Name. ||8||17||8||25||
